TRIP' (median views@72h of posts since 2026-10-21 below 375) or TikTok Studio marks any video 'not eligible for For You'. The next 'Schedule Escape Cup matches' run then fills only kill_switch_slots_uk (4/day); posts already queued in Buffer stay. A broken file falls back to the 7 slots in main.DEFAULT_DAY_SLOTS.
